whole_lifecycle_findings.observation: hurt reads DamageSource.getEntity only. A causing Player matching LIKED_PLAYER UUID returns false before parent; other paths call super. The local rejection checks neither held item, resolver range, player game mode nor nominal damage. No denial reason/visual receipt is emitted in this branch; do not extend it to arbitrary recursive projectile/pet ownership.

Interaction branch order is dancing amethyst duplication, then empty own hand plus nonempty offered item, then occupied own hand plus an empty interacting MAIN_HAND. Giving copies one template, consumes unless instabuild, requests sound and stores player UUID. Retrieval clears own hand, requests sound/swing, drains inventory to thrown item entities, erases LIKED_PLAYER, then calls player.addItem(template) and returns SUCCESS. No retriever identity-equality guard in this local branch; outer interaction authorization was not expanded.

removeAllItems snapshots nonempty stack references then clears container. Throw creates ItemEntity, sets thrower/velocity/default pickup delay and ignores addFreshEntity result. Player.addItem returns inventory.add; Allay retrieval ignores its boolean. No guarantee of settled native inventory admission. An empty main hand normally provides an available selected slot, so ignored boolean alone does not demonstrate a naturally full-inventory loss case or a security exploit.

First heard noteblock stores GlobalPos and cooldown600; same position refreshes. Deposit selection prefers a matching current dimension NOTE_BLOCK with cooldown memory present, else erases note position and falls back to liked player. getLikedPlayer resolves only a current-level ServerPlayer in survival/creative within64 and otherwise returns empty without erasing UUID. Selection validity and stored hurt-rejection identity can diverge; no atomic target/revocation receipt claimed.

Behavior registers LOOK_TARGET/WALK_TARGET/ITEM_PICKUP_COOLDOWN; start/continue require nonempty inventory and target getter present. Tick recomputes target; eye distance<3 removes one slot0 item before throw, optionally triggers ALLAY_DROP_ITEM_ON_BLOCK when a liked player resolves, then sets pickup cooldown60. Registration is not a value-absent throw gate. CountDown decrements while positive and erases on stop; do not equate requested counts to exact elapsed seconds or sound to receiver success.

Pickup needs held template and absent pickup-cooldown memory, canAddItem, same item and potion-specific comparison plus Forge griefing policy. Template lacking Potion does not enforce general full-NBT equality. InventoryCarrier uses actual add remainder/take count and discards only when remainder empty. This does not establish preservation of every Dynasty NBT variant or a task-native acquisition receipt.

Periodic server healing is independent of a rejected trusted-player hit. Death drops inventory/eligible held item without proving item-entity admission. Duplication create can fail, and addFreshEntity result is ignored after resetting cooldown; interaction SUCCESS/hearts/chime are not a child-spawn receipt. Existing migration258 wholly retains inventory/cooldown reader precision ownership.

application_to_Dynasty: Only generate a boss denial reason at the actual qualified refusal branch; passive holding/dance/heart/heal presentation does not establish cause-specific feedback. Ordinary combat must not gain unrelated gray hints.

Keep stored identity, current receiver eligibility and settled item ownership distinct; preserve native IDs/NBT and explicit admission/payment/reward receipts. These are research observations, not production changes.
